summary: Iter47 frontend-only verification of the 'flaky-when-entering-data' fix in useModalA11y + functional setState refactors. All targeted flows PASS: (1) Beta Feedback floating modal accepts independent input across name/email/message — typed 'Sarah Makes' / 'sarah@crafters.test' / 'Feedback was flaky' and all three values match exactly with no focus bouncing back to name. (2) ESC closes the Beta Feedback modal post-refactor (the moved-into-no-deps useEffect keydown handler still fires). (3) Tab cycles within the dialog (focus stays inside [role=dialog] when Tab is pressed from the submit button — focus trap intact). (4) /apply (ApplyPage) — typed distinct values into apply-name, apply-email, apply-location, apply-about; all 4 retained their values, no cross-field leakage. apply-studio_name / apply-portfolio_url were not part of the spec'd 5 but exist with correct testids. (5) /beta (BetaPage) — same: beta-name, beta-email, beta-location, beta-about retained correct values, no leakage. (6) /custom-order StepContact (step 5/5) — actual testids are co-name / co-email / co-phone (not custom-order-contact-*); typed 'Sarah Customer' / 'sarah@cust.test' / '5551234567', all three correct. Cross-field stability also verified: re-edited the name field to append '!' and email/phone remained untouched, proving the functional setState updater fix works against the stale-closure bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Naming inconsistency: the spec says StepContact uses testids 'custom-order-contact-name/email/phone' but the actual implementation uses 'co-name/co-email/co-phone'. Either is fine but the spec/handoff note is out of date — main agent should align the docstring or testids for future regression tests.

useModalA11y auto-focus useEffect has eslint-disabled exhaustive-deps and re-runs only on mount. That's exactly the fix, but consider documenting that callers MUST NOT change autoFocusSelector after mount (would no-op silently). Currently no caller does, so it's safe.

BetaBanner submit() doesn't reset status='sending' to 'idle' on the success branch — only sets 'done'. Not a bug (the success card replaces the form), but if a caller ever inspects status mid-flight after success it could look stuck. Cosmetic.

Repeated functional-setState boilerplate `(e) => { const v = e.target.value; setForm((c) => ({ ...c, name: v })); }` appears in BetaBanner, ApplyPage, BetaPage, CustomOrderPage. Worth extracting a `useFormState` helper hook to DRY this up — the bug surface area is now spread across 4 files.
test_credentials: none required — all flows tested are public/unauthenticated.
seed_data_creation: none — no records were submitted (no Send/Submit clicks were performed beyond field-typing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified testids on each surface: BetaBanner modal -> beta-feedback-btn (top) | beta-feedback-modal | beta-feedback-name | beta-feedback-email | beta-feedback-message | beta-feedback-cancel | beta-feedback-submit. ApplyPage -> apply-name | apply-email | apply-studio_name | apply-location | apply-portfolio_url | apply-about. BetaPage -> beta-name | beta-email | beta-studio_name | beta-location | beta-portfolio_url | beta-about. CustomOrderPage final step -> co-name | co-email | co-phone | custom-order-policy-checkbox; navigate to it via category-card-{slug} then 'co-next' button x4. Other useModalA11y consumers (DigestsTab, UsersTab, RotatePasswordModal, ContactMakerModal, CsvImportModal, MakerDashboard DM) were NOT smoke-tested in this run — they require admin/maker JWT seeding and a buyer/maker context that wasn't supplied. The hook itself is the only surface that changed and the public Beta Feedback modal exercises it identically (same Esc/Tab/auto-focus paths), so a regression there is statistically unlikely. If the main agent wants belt-and-braces coverage they can self-verify by signing in as admin and opening UsersTab modal → Esc closes it.
rca_of_the_issue: Confirmed fix. Original bug: useModalA11y's effect listed [onCancel, autoFocusSelector] as deps; callers passed inline () => setOpen(false) which is a fresh fn ref every render, so React re-ran the effect on every keystroke (every state set re-rendered the parent, which re-rendered the modal, which called the hook with a new onCancel). The effect's setTimeout(focus-first-input, 0) then stole focus back to the first focusable (the name input) mid-typing. Fix verified: keydown handler is now in a no-deps useEffect and onCancel is read off a ref, so the listener never re-attaches; auto-focus is in its own no-deps useEffect that runs once on mount. Repro before/after exactly matches the agent-to-agent context note. Mitigation deployed: hook split into 3 effects (callback ref sync, keydown listener mount-once, auto-focus mount-once) + functional setState updaters in 4 page/component forms to also handle the unrelated stale-closure char-drop concern at fast typing speeds.
